newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares rise, advance seen short-lived.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares rise, advance seen short-lived.

text.p: Slovenian shares continued their advance for the third consecutive day on Friday in what traders described as a technical rebound likely to run out of steam soon.

"The rebound continues as prices are still regarded as low. But I can't see any reason for a rise next week, and volumes will be low because of Wednesday's holiday," said Igor Marosa, a trader of brokerage Proxy.
* The SBI index rose 1.66 pct or 19.91 points to 1,220.7
* Drug maker Lek was the most actively traded issue, firming 2.39 percent to 22,300 tolars on volume of 337 shares for total turnover of 7.5 million tolars
* Port operator Luka was the top gainer, jumping 2.48 percent to 1,650 tolars on volume of 510 shares -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
